excerpt_i18n.en:
Original Author: WeChat Official Account "Deep Blue Embodied Intelligence"  
Original Link: https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/yGE3tLQywqf4wvsOlj6WxA  

Simultaneously supporting dual-arm coordination and high-degree-of-freedom fine manipulation with dexterous hands — an end-to-end VLA model.  

Previous mainstream VLA systems either focused on low-degree-of-freedom gripper control for dual arms or specialized in high-degree-of-freedom dexterous hand operations for a single arm, failing to address the dual requirements of dual-arm coordination and fine finger movements. For example, tasks like piston insertion require precise dual-arm coordination, while unscrewing bottle caps or fine object grasping rely on multi-finger flexible control. Such tasks have long lacked a unified VLA solution.  

Recently, the first open-source VLA model natively designed for dual-arm, dual-high-degree-of-freedom (36 degrees of freedom) dexterous manipulation, Dexora, broke the morphological barriers of previous VLAs, offering a new paradigm for the deployment of general-purpose dexterous robots.  

Hardware and Teleoperation: A Dexterous Data Foundation for Virtual-Real Collaboration  

The core prerequisite for high-degree-of-freedom dexterous manipulation is precise and scalable data collection. Dexora abandons single teleoperation solutions, adopting a hybrid "exoskeleton + VR" teleoperation system that simultaneously drives physical robots and MuJoCo digital twins, addressing the precision and scalability challenges of data collection at their root.  

▲ Schematic of Dexora hardware and hybrid teleoperation system © [Deep Blue Embodied Intelligence] Compilation  

On the hardware level, Dexora is equipped with two 6-degree-of-freedom AIRBOT robotic arms and a pair of 12-degree-of-freedom XHAN

Autor original: Cuenta pública "Deep Blue Embodied Intelligence"

Soporta simultáneamente la coordinación de dos brazos y la operación de alta libertad con dos manos diestras — Modelo VLA de extremo a extremo  
Los sistemas VLA convencionales anteriores se centraban en el control de pinzas de baja libertad con dos brazos, o se especializaban en la operación de manos diestras de alta libertad con un solo brazo, sin poder satisfacer la doble demanda de coordinación de dos brazos y movimientos finos de los dedos.  
Por ejemplo, la inserción de un pistón requiere una coordinación precisa de ambos brazos, mientras que acciones como girar una tapa de botella o recoger objetos pequeños dependen de la regulación flexible de múltiples dedos. Este tipo de tareas carecía durante mucho tiempo de una solución VLA unificada.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 6月1日，美团一季度财报电话会上，王兴表示，美团AI助手“小美”与腾讯元宝的合作将于近期上线。届时，用户可直接在“元宝”中输入诉求，通过“小美”调用外卖等本地生活服务，帮助用户更便捷无缝地完成一站式本地生活服务的交易。王兴认为，未来除了服务消费者（To C）和商家（To B），服务AI Agent（To A）正变得越来越重要。
excerpt_i18n.en: On June 1, during Meituan's Q1 earnings call, Wang Xing announced that the collaboration between Meituan's AI assistant "Xiao Mei" and Tencent's Yuanbao will launch soon. At that time, users can directly input requests into Yuanbao and use Xiao Mei to access local life services such as food delivery, enabling a more convenient and seamless one-stop transaction experience for local life services. Wang Xing believes that in the future, in addition to serving consumers (To C) and merchants (To B), serving AI agents (To A) is becoming increasingly important.
excerpt_i18n.es: El 1 de junio, en la conferencia telefónica sobre los resultados del primer trimestre de Meituan, Wang Xing anunció que la colaboración entre el asistente de IA "Xiaomei" de Meituan y Tencent Yuanbao se lanzará próximamente. En ese momento, los usuarios podrán ingresar directamente sus solicitudes en "Yuanbao" y, a través de "Xiaomei", acceder a servicios de vida local como pedidos de comida, facilitando transacciones integradas y sin interrupciones.
